category: tunnel (hosted): HTTP/HTTPS tunnel with reserved subdomains, custom domains and a global server network, USD 79 per user per year

free_tier.stated: no free allowance on this tier; Pro is USD 79 per user per year, with no time limit

retention.stated: persistent URLs and reserved subdomains; no time limit

egress.terms: no byte cap or transfer tolerance is published on the home page or the documentation pages read; Pro has no time limit

interface_detail: expose share http://localhost:3000; a web dashboard shows and replays the requests
tooling: a PHP client (PHAR archive or Composer package, bundled in Laravel Herd) logs in to the managed server with an account token
chaining: HTTP and HTTPS only on the pages read, so it fronts a web origin and is not a UDP forward or a WireGuard ingress. The open source PHP server can be run by the user on a rented or free machine as the last option.

limits.value: no byte cap and no bandwidth tolerance is published for Pro

limits_note: Nothing countable is published for the paid tier either.
binding_note: Nothing countable is published: Pro states no time limit and no byte cap, so no quota can be shown to fail first at 1 TiB per month. The tolerance is unpublished.

identity_cost.detail: an account with full name, email address and password, or sign-in with GitHub or Google; the plan cards say no card is needed to get started, and the checkout was not opened

reliability_note: Pro uses the nearest server of a global network; the price is net of local taxes and VAT.
confidence_note: Home page pricing cards read on 2026-11-03; the checkout was not opened, so the payment method is unverified.

evidence.proved: the Pro tier costs USD 79 per user per year
Pro includes the global server network

evidence.quote: Expose opens your browser, where you sign in with your email address, GitHub or Google.
evidence.proved: sign-in is by email, GitHub or Google

evidence.quote: Expose allows you to share any kind of HTTP/HTTPS traffic for websites that you can reach on your own computer, with anyone on the internet and there are multiple ways to share a site with Expose.
evidence.proved: the traffic shared is HTTP and HTTPS

notes: Team is USD 229 per team per year for up to 10 users. Paid-tier counterpart of the Hobby record; the home page publishes no byte cap for it.

extras.transit_note: the tunnel relays the bytes of the origin
extras.volume_stated: not published on the pages read
